pr_title: Fix animation when adding new Bezier track.
pr_body:
Fix the reported issue #81929 

The issue was caused due to `insert_queue` was prematurely set to false before awaiting dialog confirmation for track insertion. Additionally, refactored the code to eliminate redundancy and enhance code reusability.

* *Bugsquad edit, fixes: #81929*
pr_comments: To link the issue you need to put `fixes` ahead of the issue number, I have fixed this for you but keep this in mind in the future

issue_context.title: Animation: when adding new Bezier track, first key value is not recorded (is always 0)
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.1.1.stable.official [bd6af8e0e]

### System information

Godot v4.1.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS 22.04 - Vulkan (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 4600 (HSW GT2) () - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4710HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

When recording an animation key with the key button near a property for the first time, user is prompted to create a new track. If user selects to Use Bezier Curves, the new bezier curve will start at 0 instead of taking the current value = recorded key value as start value.

![Godot 4 1 1 - new Bezier track does not remember first new key value](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/1067772/0ea6ca92-70d8-4af7-aa33-837105ca8346)


### Steps to reproduce

0. Setup: either download the MRP below, or create a Sprite2D + AnimationPlayer under some parent node.
1. Click on the AnimationPlayer or Animation pane to enable Animation mode.
2. Click on the Sprite2D node. You should see key buttons near every property.
3. Rotate the Sprite2D via Rotate Mode (E) or directly by dragging the Rotation slider to some non-0 value
4. Click on the key button to record the value
5. In the prompt popup, make sure to check Use Bezier Curves
6. Verify the key value: it is 0
7. Drag animation time a little to force refresh rotation: sprite is back to no rotation

### Minimal reproduction project

[Godot 4.1.1 - Animation key on new track does not remember new value.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/12660935/Godot.4.1.1.-.Animation.key.on.new.track.does.not.remember.new.value.zip)
comments:
It's worse than I thought: in some cases, it will also not remember future key value changes.

![Godot 4 1 1 - new Bezier track does not remember further key values](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/1067772/d3abe0bf-2431-412a-8dd5-0cc393f8c171)

It worked the other times I tried it and now it's 100% repro on the leg. I'm not sure what the conditions are, you can try to repro this on the MWR...

I don't see any usable workaround (the only 100% reliable action is to select the key point and set the value directly, which defeats the point of visual editing), so I'm stuck and unable to animate my character body parts at the moment...

review_comments: How are you ensuring that this code still works?
